_comment: The knockout round names, shared by BOTH language implementations:
roundLabelFromEnd in internal/engine/errors.go (the round a refusal or a
roundLabelFromEnd in web-mobile/js/bracket.jsx (the heading over each
bracket column, reached through bracketRoundLabel). Keyed by the match's
the JS side over this same file.
Why a shared file: a dialog that says "Match 3 (Semifinals)" sends the
operator to the column headed Semifinals, so the two spellings must not
drift. Changing one language and its own tests together is the realistic
drift, and two independent tables both stay green through it; editing
this file fails the other language's suite at once.
